subject: Final-push conversion stipend for GreenLane pilot
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lopez <samantha.lopez@greenlane.ai>
Cc: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@greenlane.ai>
Date: 2027-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Final-push conversion stipend for GreenLane pilot

Hi Samantha —

Congrats again on the pilot milestones this week. We’re seeing strong signal on the intent-to-deploy indicators you shared (inference ops, latency retention, and cost-per-call). To help you get across the finish line before the end of the quarter, I can offer a one-time conversion stipend: $20k of usage credits applied to your first three months after contract execution.

High-level terms:
- Credits applied at invoice time (line item: EOQ stipend)
- One-time, non-recurring — intended to offset initial usage during ramp
- Requires a signed MSA and mutual action plan by 2027-06-30

If that works, I’ll run the approval with finance and legal and send a DocuSign for the MAP + MSA. Would you like us to extend the pilot window by two weeks as part of this to give your infra team more runway?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if helpful.

—
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198

Karthik —

Thanks — this is helpful. Quick Qs from our side: 1) Is the stipend tied to committed spend or just applied pro-rata to invoices? 2) Any strings on data residency or additional security controls? Procurement wants to see a simple summary we can route to legal.

Yes on extending the pilot by two weeks — that would help the infra team finish load-testing. Can you include the MAP timeline in the doc you send?

Best,
Samantha
VP, Product
GreenLane AI

Folks —

Forwarding GreenLane’s ask and their acceptance of a two-week pilot extension. I proposed a $20k one-time credit to help close this quarter; they want confirmation on whether it’s applied pro-rata or tied to a commit. Procurement is on the thread.

Quick context: 6-week pilot, meaningful P50 latency improvement on our model, early cost projections look like a 3–4x reduction vs their current provider after caching and batching configs. This is a high strategic fit (AI-native vertical).

Requested: can we approve a $20k EOQ stipend to be billed as a credit line item (non-recurring)? Also confirm any legal/finance boilerplate needed for the MAP signature by 6/30.

Thanks — I can jump on a call if helpful.

—
Karthik

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-06-25T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Final-push conversion stipend for GreenLane pilot — approval request

Karthik / team —

Approve the $20k stipend as a one-time invoice credit. Finance is comfortable with this structure if we document it as a non-recurring promotional credit and add a 90-day clawback clause if the account churns before 90 days (standard). No commit required — credits will be applied pro-rata to invoices until exhausted.

Conditions:
- Signed MAP + MSA by 2027-06-30
- Procurement to confirm no additional PO terms that materially change revenue recognition
- Legal to include the 90-day clawback language (I’ve looped Alex for legal wording)

I’ll attach an approval stub for records.

—
Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Final-push conversion stipend for GreenLane pilot

Samantha —

Thanks for the quick reply. Per finance, the offer is: $20,000 one-time usage credit, applied pro-rata to invoices until exhausted. We’ll include the 90-day clawback language in the MSA as a standard protective measure. No residency change — this is purely billing-side.

Next steps I’m attaching: 
- Signed MAP + MSA via DocuSign (I’ll send the link once legal adds the clawback clause)
- EOQ credit approval PDF for your procurement records (attached)

Would you like me to route the DocuSign to procurement and legal directly (procurement@greenlane.ai)? If so, we’ll mark the MAP timeline for the two-week pilot extension and target go-live acceptance on 2027-07-15.

Best,
Karthik
